proposed_widenings.name: passive_scope_modifier
proposed_widenings.justification: Deflect Energy is a permanent always-on modifier that widens the damage type filter on Deflect Attacks. It has no activation cost, no use count, no resource, and no trigger — the activation family cannot represent it without lying about all of those fields.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can now use your Deflect Attacks feature against attacks that deal any damage type, not just Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing.

proposed_widenings.name: expand_damage_type_scope (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Even if a passive family existed, no current ClassFeatureEffect variant can express 'remove the damage type restriction on feature X'. A new effect variant is needed that names the target feature and declares the restriction being lifted.

notes: Deflect Energy is a pure passive upgrade — it widens the eligibility filter of Deflect Attacks from physical-only to all damage types. The existing class_feature/activation family requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence, none of which apply here. ClassFeatureEffect has no 'expand_scope' variant. Two widenings are needed: (1) a new family for always-on passive class feature modifiers (passive_scope_modifier or similar), and (2) a new ClassFeatureEffect variant that references the target feature and the constraint being removed. No honest encoding is possible in the current surface.
